scope: Read-only current-news recall benchmark. No historical backfill or production posting was performed.
verificationPolicy: A case is benchmark-eligible only when its official source page or document is independently reachable and the event is materially real-estate/development related. User-supplied examples without an independently verified official page remain unverified and are not used for recall percentages.

cases.title: DDA Janta Awaas Yojana Phase II 2026
cases.sourceEvidence: Official DDA circular register lists the 24-09-2026 Phase II launch and current housing circulars.
cases.primaryMiss: Authority page is configured through broader DDA surfaces, but this dated circular/register event was not present in the production evidence baseline.
cases.requiredFix: Treat official DDA housing circular/public-notice registers as first-class paginated authority listings; follow document links and extract the circular date before classification.

cases.title: IDA Scheme 103, Scheme 134, Scheme 78 Aranya and Scheme 114 sale notices
cases.sourceEvidence: Official IDA sale register lists dated residential flats, row-houses, residential plots and lottery notices.
cases.primaryMiss: The authority register is a table with document/detail links and mixed Hindi-English titles; broad homepage fetching is insufficient.
cases.requiredFix: Add an authority-table adapter with detail/document traversal, bilingual title retention, and event-date extraction.

cases.title: Advertisement and booklet for sale of tenement of Nashik Board Lottery September 2026
cases.sourceEvidence: Official MHADA Nashik Board page lists the September 2026 advertisement, booklet and results.
cases.primaryMiss: The board page exposes document-backed notices whose material event is in linked PDF/detail pages.
cases.requiredFix: Follow MHADA board notice links, retain Marathi/English title text, and require readable document evidence before a publish candidate.

cases.title: Kota UIT/KDA residential and commercial scheme/auction notices
cases.sourceEvidence: Official Rajasthan UDH/UIT Kota page exposes e-auction services and Kota authority contact/surface links.
cases.primaryMiss: Authority services are linked from a government portal and do not behave like a normal RSS/news feed.
cases.requiredFix: Add Kota authority notice/e-auction surfaces and classify only dated residential/commercial scheme events with document evidence.

cases.title: UP RERA press-release register and project approval releases
cases.sourceEvidence: Official UP RERA press-release register exposes English/Hindi release rows and View File document links.
cases.primaryMiss: The register uses portal/postback document delivery; a row can be discovered while the full release remains unreadable, preventing safe city routing.
cases.requiredFix: Capture document href/postback metadata, fetch the document through a bounded adapter, extract district/project evidence, and route only evidence-backed cities.

cases.title: GujRERA registered-project and announcements surfaces
cases.sourceEvidence: Official GujRERA portal exposes public project search, announcements and regulatory document surfaces.
cases.primaryMiss: A public search portal is not itself a positive news event; project approvals/events need event-specific extraction and city evidence.
cases.requiredFix: Do not auto-publish search rows. Add event/announcement-specific adapters and keep uncertain project records in review.

cases.title: HRERA Gurugram project search and document surfaces
cases.sourceEvidence: Official HRERA Gurugram project search page is reachable and exposes project/document search, but the supplied Rohtak/Palwal/Ambala examples were not independently verified as exact current records here.
cases.primaryMiss: The source surface is verified, but exact project/event discovery requires query/detail traversal rather than homepage scraping.
cases.requiredFix: Build a read-only query/detail adapter with explicit district/project evidence and no source-level city fallback.

cases.title: CIDCO Navi Mumbai development/redevelopment notices
cases.sourceEvidence: Official CIDCO portal is configured and reachable as an authority surface; the supplied 1567-society example was not independently verified as one exact current page here.
cases.primaryMiss: The authority homepage is not equivalent to the relevant notice/category/archive surface.
cases.requiredFix: Discover and monitor CIDCO notice/category/archive links, retaining Marathi titles and explicit Navi Mumbai/sector evidence.

cases.title: Coimbatore TNHB, Warangal Housing Board, Raigad Pen, Bhavnagar, Jabalpur and Ujjain examples
cases.sourceEvidence: Supplied in Task42 brief; no exact official article/document URL was independently confirmed in this read-only benchmark.
cases.primaryMiss: Cannot calculate recall or assign a pipeline loss cause without a verified external record.
cases.requiredFix: Verify each exact official notice/document first; then add it as an individually scored benchmark row.
